descriptor.scene: Maya stands small in the lower left, seen from three-quarters BEHIND, her head and body pointed the same way: toward the place the myth promised, in morning light before her: the closed portal exactly as its locked closed plate paints it, a flat quiet ring of pale gold blossoms on the forest floor, moss and ferns grown back inside, small flat unmarked stones at its edge, worn ground where years of visitors have stood. No portal light anywhere in the image. Her shoulders have just dropped; the machete hangs loose in her right hand; in her left hand, at her side, a worn folded myth-page with soft suggested (unreadable) lines. Morning light through the canopy falls gently on the blossom ring, which sits right-of-center at middle distance; the mood is quiet disappointment without any horror, a found grave of a door that was real. Lower right corner above the caption card stays calm ferns and path.
negatives: Maya's face in more than sliver profile
a second portal, second oval of light or second blossom ring anywhere in the image
any portal light or glow from the blossom ring
descriptor._caption: She follows the most famous myth in the jungle to the place where a great portal once stood. It is exactly where the story said: a quiet ring of pale gold flowers in the green. It has been closed for years. The myth was true. It was just finished.

prompt: Picture-book spread painted in the warm editorial ink-and-wash register of the FIRST reference image. THE FIRST REFERENCE IMAGE IS A STYLE ANCHOR ONLY. Match it for MEDIUM, BRUSHWORK, PALETTE and LIGHT QUALITY ONLY, and take NO subject from it whatsoever: none of its objects, figures, costume, props, furniture, architecture, period or location may appear in the output unless the scene description below asks for them by name. SCENE: Maya stands small in the lower left, seen from three-quarters BEHIND, her head and body pointed the same way: toward the place the myth promised, in morning light before her: the closed portal exactly as its locked closed plate paints it, a flat quiet ring of pale gold blossoms on the forest floor, moss and ferns grown back inside, small flat unmarked stones at its edge, worn ground where years of visitors have stood. No portal light anywhere in the image. Morning light through the canopy falls gently on the blossom ring, which sits right-of-center at middle distance; the mood is quiet disappointment without any horror, a found grave of a door that was real. Lower right corner above the caption card stays calm ferns and path. THE CAMERA MOVES; NOTHING ELSE DOES. Every person keeps the exact seat, side and place the setting's blocking gives them, and if a BLOCKING PLATE is supplied it is the authority on who sits where: obey it at every distance. Whatever the subject is sitting at, leaning on or standing beside is STILL IN THIS PICTURE, in the near foreground if the camera is close. Everyone else present in this place is STILL PRESENT in the picture, behind or beside the subject, soft and out of focus if they are not the subject, and NOBODY leaves and NO seat empties because the camera came closer. FRAMING, TWO-SHOT: TWO figures fill the middle of the frame from the waist up and are the subject of the picture. The camera is closer than an establishing view. Behind them the place falls away softly and out of focus, present but never competing with them. maya rendered exactly per the supplied reference images: half black half white founder; sage olive blazer single button notch lapel sleeves pushed to elbow; white crew neck tee; stone khaki chinos never blue jeans; laptop under arm; warm editorial register. MAYA: a founder, half-Black and half-white, in her sage-olive single-button notch-lapel blazer with the sleeves pushed to the elbow, plain WHITE crew-neck tee, STONE KHAKI chinos (never blue jeans, never denim trousers), white sneakers, and a closed silver laptop carried under her left arm. Earnest, capable, warm. Warm-editorial ink-and-wash, never photoreal. Identity of record; wardrobe and features exactly as the locked sheets. the-portal exactly as its reference plate: A doorway of pure warm light hidden in the jungle: one upright pointed-oval of warm golden light, soft-edged like wet ink-wash with a thin brighter rim, its lower tip floating a hand's width above the forest floor. No frame, no ring, no arch, no standing stones, no machinery, no doorsill: the light alone is the door. Each era gets exactly one portal, and it shrinks: the more founders pass through and the longer it stands open, the smaller it gets, until it closes and leaves a flat ring of pale gold blossoms on the forest floor. Every portal in every era is this same design at some size. This era's portal at its opening is 3.8 m tall by 2.0 m wide: about twice a person's height, so a founder walks in without ducking and an adult's head reaches only halfway up the opening. Waning, the same shape shrinks to about 1.0 m, knee-to-waist high on an adult. Closed, a flat blossom ring about 2.0 m across lies on the forest floor. The lower tip always floats a hand's width (0.15 m) above the floor. The portal stands still; it never drifts, tilts or hovers higher. State-dependent only. Hidden: hanging vines, broad leaves and leaf-shadow curtain the light so only warm slivers show through; a passerby would walk within arm's length and never know. Master (found): the vines drawn aside, the oval open and generous, warm gold light with a few small drifting motes, soft warm glow on the nearest leaves. Waning: the same portal small and low, light gentler, the green closing in around it. Closed: no light at all, a quiet flat ring of pale gold blossoms in the green, moss and ferns grown back inside it. Nothing is ever scorched, broken or ominous. At its opening, about twice a person's height and wider than a garden gate; a closed ring reads about as wide as a person is tall lying down. In a wide shot the live portal is a tall warm almond of light against the green, unmistakably person-scaled, never building-scaled and never coin-scaled. THE ONLY CHARACTERS IN THIS IMAGE ARE: maya. NOBODY ELSE APPEARS. Do not add any other person, figure, creature, robot, animal or bystander, whatever the style description above may suggest. NEGATIVES: neon, 3D/CGI/Pixar, glossy plastic, HUD/arc-reactor comic vocabulary, neo-comic, Maya's face in more than sliver profile, readable letters on the page, a second portal, second oval of light or second blossom ring anywhere in the image, any portal light or glow from the blossom ring. ONE SINGLE CONTINUOUS FULL-BLEED PAINTING that fills the entire canvas edge to edge. This is NEVER a grid, NEVER a multi-panel layout, NEVER a comic page, NEVER a contact sheet, NEVER a study or turnaround sheet, NEVER a collage, and NEVER several framed views side by side. Some reference images supplied to you are multi-panel study sheets; use them ONLY for the identity and design of what they depict, and NEVER copy their panelled layout into the output. The output has exactly ONE camera, ONE moment, and NO internal borders, frames, gutters, or dividing lines of any kind. HANDS. Every hand in this image has EXACTLY FOUR FINGERS AND ONE THUMB, five digits and no more and no fewer, and every person has exactly TWO hands and TWO arms. No sixth finger, no extra thumb, no duplicated or spare limb, and no hand emerging from a place no arm reaches. Two hands that come near each other stay SEPARATE and readable as two hands: they never merge into one mass, never share fingers and never fuse at the knuckles. Each hand is joined to a wrist of believable thickness, the wrist to a forearm, and the forearm to the shoulder of the person it belongs to. Hands are sized to their owner: never oversized, never doll-small. A hand resting ON something makes real contact with THAT thing, with the fingers following its actual surface and not floating above it or sinking into it.
